finding.text: Ask 7 wants "the dropped items highlighted", but the page's default run (`runs/sample/`, ext/Refine/page.js:13) has 0 dropped and 0 context rows (the header reads "9 sentences · 9 asks · 0 context · 0 dropped · 5 flags" in 127-0-0-1-65317-framework-ext-Refine/sheet.png). So the first page never shows a drop. Default to run `c` or the fixture, which have dropped rows, so the core promise is visible on arrival.

The readme contradicts the page. ext/Refine/readme.md:19 says the Overview shows "the fixture run … with every coverage outcome", but page.js:12 loads `runs/sample/`. Make one of them match the other; defaulting to the fixture fixes this and finding 1 together.

At 1280px the four columns are about 140px wide each, and the body text wraps every 3–4 words (the 1280 frame of ext-Refine/sheet.png). Raw and Clean are nearly the same text side by side, so the reader scans two tall, thin walls. Below about 1600px, show Raw and Clean as tabs in one column, or stack the ladder to two columns.

The coverage table, which is the point of the task (ask 3), sits below the fold in every frame. Only the one-line count is visible. Put it (or at least its dropped and flagged rows) beside Brief, or above the ladder, so "what did I actually say?" is on the first screen.

audit.md says honestly that `coverage.md` can't be trusted yet: it caught 0–2 of the real drops per run, and it caught none of the "suggestion became a rule" cases. The range-citation bug is now fixed in `citationsIn` (Server/refine.mjs, diff line 756), but runs a/b/c were made before the fix and were not re-run. Their coverage.md files still carry the false "dropped" rows.

The audit's own "biggest change" is still undone: check coverage per idea, not per sentence. Without it, a long spoken sentence counts as covered while part of it is lost (A's S28 and S67). Log this as the next task, so the tool isn't taken as proof of "nothing lost".

Ask 4's scoreboard exists (Server/refine-scoreboard.jsonl), but the one `--collab` run ended in a 1–1 tie broken by price, and neither caveat was applied (audit.md, "added nothing" for $0.31). Collab's value for this job is unproven. Say so on the card rather than leave `--collab` looking recommended.
Ask 5 names the VS Code tab. new-task, sub-mastermind and every-prompt now mention refine.mjs, but nothing reaches the VS Code tab itself. Its instructions are still a hand summary.

Reuse is done well. ask-each.mjs gained an `export { askOnce }` plus an is-main guard, and collab.mjs gained a small `phase.given` hook (collab.mjs:335). No third engine was written. At about 840 lines, refine.mjs is large for a first cut, and the `--coverage-only`/`--repair-only` modes could wait.

ext/sheet.png: the Refine tile lands last in the Ext grid, matching its `children:` order in ext/page.js:9, and its description is readable. The navigation is fine. The left nav in the Refine frames is cut off before "Refine", as it is for every late ext module.

The card for ask 7 isn't in the diff (page.js links `/framework/ai2/2026/09/29/from-dictation-to-a-brief-with-nothing-l/` with a sample/a/b/c picker), so I couldn't verify its picker or its dropped highlighting from these files.
